name: @okfit/mcp

tools.name: describe_vocabulary
tools.description: Returns this project's resolved okfit configuration: project root, bundle root, active profile, agent actor, every concept type and tag the config declares, and docs_presets, the active profile's Surface templates (empty without a profile). Call this first, before filtering or writing any concept, to learn which names exist.

tools.name: list_concepts
tools.description: Lists concept summaries, filtered by exact type, tags that must all be present (AND), status, verified (true: current human verification; false: never verified), drifted or stale. Each summary carries tier, integrity and stale. now (ISO-8601 with offset) sets the staleness time. Pages by limit (default 200, max 1000) and offset, with total. An unknown type or tag fails with the valid names.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: Returns one concept by id: its decoded frontmatter, raw markdown, bundle-relative path, every outgoing link (with where it was written and whether the target is a concept, a file, or missing), and its okfit trust signal: tier, integrity, stale and drift. Accepts a tolerant id, with or without a leading slash or trailing .md.

tools.name: concept_neighbors
tools.description: Returns the graph neighbours of one concept: everything it links to (outgoing) and everything that links to it (incoming), each with the node kind and, for a concept target, its full summary. Use it after get_concept to walk the bundle's link graph one hop at a time without loading every concept.

tools.name: stale_report
tools.description: Lists every stale or drifted concept. items: stale_after passed, each with its summary, the date and whole days past. drifted: human-verified concepts whose content changed since (or was never bound), with the reason and last editor. Uses the current time unless now is given (ISO-8601 with an explicit offset).

tools.name: validate_bundle
tools.description: Returns the report `okfit validate --format json` prints, unchanged: each diagnostic's file, code, severity, message and range, the summary counts and the CLI's exit code. Call it after editing any concept file. Optional documents: [{ path, text }] (bundle-relative, e.g. metrics/churn.md) stand in for disk, a file not yet written under an existing directory included; nothing is written.

instructions: okfit-mcp serves one Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundle: the okf/ directory of the project it was launched in. Every tool is read-only and answers from the bundle as it is on disk at call time. Start with describe_vocabulary to learn the concept types and tags this project's config declares, then list_concepts to find ids; get_concept, concept_neighbors, stale_report and validate_bundle take those ids. Concept ids are bundle-relative paths without the .md extension (for example decisions/cli-exit-codes). Every successful tools/call result carries the typed payload in structuredContent and a JSON rendering in content[0].text. A failed call is isError: true with the human message and a remediation hint in content[0].text and no structuredContent; read that text before retrying. Each concept carries an okfit trust signal next to its OKF trust tier: integrity is current when a human verified exactly the current content, drifted when it changed since (the reason says why), and none when no human verified it; stale means past stale_after. Drifted concepts are safe to edit and read, but weigh them below current ones; only a human re-verifies. Resources: okf://index is the bundle's root index.md, and okf://concept/<id> is one static resource per concept.
